title: mergus_plan
description: The plan: what a run would compute or skip for the selected models, each decision with its reason, identified by its hash (MG-REQ-0714, MG-REQ-0742). Every list is sorted by byte order unless stated.

contract_version.description: The major version of the contract.

plan_id.description: The lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the plan without `plan_id` (MG-REQ-0743).

mergus_version.description: The version of Mergus that made the plan.

environment.description: The environment the plan is for (MG-REQ-0296.5).

max_parallel.description: The most steps of one parallel group (MG-REQ-0744.1).

selected.description: The names of the selected models.

steps.description: One step per selected model, sorted by parallel group and then by model name (MG-REQ-0744.3).

stale_upstream.description: The models left out of the selection, upstream of a selected model, whose result is stale (MG-REQ-0745), sorted by model.

gates.description: The gates of stage 4, in the order of the gate table of `run/gates.md`, each with its status (MG-REQ-0747.3, MG-REQ-0720, MG-REQ-0722). Absent before phase 0.4.

step.description: The decision for one selected model.

model_id.description: The stable identifier of the model (MG-REQ-0368).

fingerprint.description: The lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of what the model's result depends on (MG-REQ-0711, MG-REQ-0743).

inputs.description: The tables the model reads: lowercase, a model bare, a raw table as `raw.<table>`.

action.description: Whether the model is computed or its available result reused (MG-REQ-0744.2).

refresh.description: What is computed: the whole result.

parallel_group.description: The parallel group of the step, from 1 (MG-REQ-0744.3).

incremental.description: How an incremental step recomputes its result; when present, `refresh` describes nothing and readers use it (MG-REQ-0747.4, MG-REQ-0652, MG-REQ-0653).

segments.description: The segments of the model in execution order (MG-REQ-0747.1, MG-REQ-0631).

boundaries.description: The boundaries between segments, sorted by `from` and then by `to` (MG-REQ-0747.1).

periods.description: The periods the model recomputes, sorted by `start`; present only when `incremental.mode` is `period`, and empty when nothing is recomputed (MG-REQ-0747.2, MG-REQ-0652).

stale.description: A model left out of the selection whose result is stale.

include.description: The selector that includes it: `+<model>` of the first selected model downstream of it, in name order.

incremental.description: The incremental refresh of a step.

mode.description: What is recomputed: `period` the periods of `periods` (MG-REQ-0652), `key` the rows of changed keys (MG-REQ-0653).

segment.description: A run of the model's steps on one engine (MG-REQ-0631).

index.description: The position of the segment in execution order, from 0.

engine.description: The engine that runs the segment.

steps.description: The names of the model's steps the segment runs, in order.

polars_level.description: How Polars runs the segment; present only when `engine` is `polars` (MG-REQ-0635).

polars_reason.description: Why that level was chosen; present only when `engine` is `polars` (MG-REQ-0635).

boundary.description: Where data crosses from one segment to another (MG-REQ-0633).

from.description: The index of the segment the data leaves.

to.description: The index of the segment the data enters.

columns.description: The names of the columns crossing, in their output order.

start.description: The start of the period, an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC.

end.description: The end of the period, an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC.

gate.description: One gate of stage 4 and its status (MG-REQ-0720).
The name of the gate in the gate table of `run/gates.md`.

status.description: Whether the gate passes, blocks, or is not applicable yet.

phase.description: The phase the gate is due in, such as `0.5`; present only when `status` is `not_applicable`.

errors.description: Why the gate blocks; present only when `status` is `block` (MG-REQ-0722).

gate_error.description: One error of a blocking gate (MG-REQ-0008).

step.description: The step of the model that caused it.
